lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters organized into vertical columns. In the mid-lateral region, vertical spacing between spot centroids is approximately 1.5 to 2 times the average spot diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance spots, creating a coordinate-like lattice where the spots serve as anchor nodes on the vertical axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-frequency distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots, with spatial density increasing significantly toward the distal margin of the fin.
